counterevidence_considered.description: Against my verdict: the workflow does construct a complemented panel (complement_calls = 1 - panel_call), which is the exact ingredient of the in-scope issue class. However, tracing every use of complement_calls shows it feeds only flip_flags/flip_agreement_count, which appears solely in the QC line of the report (strand-flip QC count: 6); it does not touch agreement_flags, agreement_rate, or the emission product, and the report accurately discloses this scope.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: complement used only in QC count, not in emission accumulation

source_refs.quoted_text: complement_calls = [1 - value for value in panel_calls]

flip_flags = [concordance_indicator(observed_calls[index], complement_calls[index]) for index in range(unit_count)]
flip_agreement_count = sum(flip_flags)

It feeds this quality-control line only and never enters the emission accumulation.
Units whose array_call equals the complemented panel_call (strand-flip QC count): 6

evidence.description: The emission accumulation multiplies emission_factor(observed, panel_calls[index]) over all units, using the panel values in their supplied coding; complement_calls never enters this loop.

source_refs.quoted_text:
for index in range(unit_count):
    emission_value = emission_value * emission_factor(observed_calls[index], panel_calls[index])

evidence.description: The reported per-unit agreement rate is likewise computed from supplied-coding comparisons (agreement_flags against panel_calls), and independent recomputation from inputs/data.csv confirms 18/24 concordant units (mismatches at BAR-003, 006, 011, 014, 019, 022), rate 0.750000, and emission product (1/2)^6 = 1/64, all matching the report.

source_refs.quoted_text:
agreement_flags = [concordance_indicator(observed_calls[index], panel_calls[index]) for index in range(unit_count)]
agreement_count = sum(agreement_flags)
Per-unit agreement rate used by the emission accumulation: 0.750000 (18/24)

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I actively tried to demonstrate the issue is present, since a complemented panel is literally constructed in this workflow. I traced every reference to complement_calls and flip_flags: they terminate in the single QC report line and never reach agreement_flags, agreement_rate, or the emission_value loop, which reference panel_calls directly. I then recomputed the numbers both ways from the data: supplied coding gives 18/24 concordant, rate 0.750000, product (1/2)^6 = 1/64; complement coding would give 6/24, rate 0.250000, product (1/2)^18 = 1/262144. The report's rate, product, and log10 (-1.806180 = log10(1/64)) all match the supplied coding and none match the complement coding. I also verified the QC count of 6 equals the complement-coding concordance, consistent with its disclosed role. I could not construct a reading under which the complemented panel influenced the emission-weighted result.
